reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so the sachet-to-go idea solves a problem I don't have. The named lab and batch report are good, but that alone doesn't make me switch from what I have.
objection: I don't need a portable format, and I'd be paying about $30 for a convenience when my current bottle is cheaper per day. I'd also want to read the actual lab report before trusting it.
would_change_my_mind: A price clearly lower than what I pay now for a tested magnesium bisglycinate, plus a real lab report I can open and check.
